title: Controlled Sniffer Hatching
description: Prevents sniffer eggs from hatching unless placed on moss blocks.
body:
_Have you ever wanted to openly display your sniffer eggs in their own special exhibit? Are you annoyed with the inconsistent egg hatching mechanics between turtles and sniffers? Do you just want a unique building block?_

# Introducing: Controlled Sniffer Hatching!

![The banner and icon source image for the Controlled Sniffer Hatching mod.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/aPNqwwOv/images/5663d59d29f17da3fc2b94b29c5f7af960491941.png)

### Features

* Whenever you place down a sniffer egg, it won't hatch unless the block beneath it is either a **Moss Block** or a **Pale Moss Block.**
  * If a sniffer egg is placed down on moss, and then the moss is swapped out for an invalid hatching block, the egg will keep any cracks it already has, but it will not advance to the next hatching stage unless it is pushed back onto moss with a piston.
* **Moss Blocks** retain their vanilla ability to halve the time it takes for a sniffer egg to hatch. It will take **10 minutes** for the egg to hatch on these blocks.
* **Pale Moss Blocks** do _not_ receive the halved time bonus. It will take **20 minutes** for the egg to hatch on these blocks.

### Version Requirements

* Minecraft 26.1.0 or later
* Fabric Loader 0.19.3
